claims.statement: U.S. customs bill-of-lading records (aggregated by ImportKey): KSH International Ltd shipped 'CONTINUOUSLY TRANSPOSED CONDUCTORS CTC' to 'VIRGINIA TRANSFORMER CORP' (arrival 2026-10-12, Los Angeles) and 'CONTINUOUSLY TRANSPOSED CONDUCTORS AND PAPER COVERED COPPER CONDUCTORS STRIPS' to 'GEORGIA TRANSFORMER CORP' (arrival 2026-10-14, Savannah).
